handback.title: Split stories that share a file wait before planning
handback.summary: Stories of a split name their files, and one waits unplanned while another in-flight change touches the same file.
handback.feature: Parallel stories never clash: each names its files, and code holds back any story whose files other running work is changing.

stories.title: Every split story names the files it changes
stories.user_story: Each story of an approved split lists the files it will change, checked by code before filing.
stories.context: Today a split's stories carry no file list: the planner check of stories (check_stories in dokima/planner.py) reads only titles, criteria and depends_on, and file_split in dokima/agent_autopilot.py files them. The fence (dokima/fence.py) already holds a worker to its plan's files. Keep the file list in the split's record so later code can read it.

acceptance_criteria.text: A split's plan gives every story a list of the files it will change, new files marked new.
acceptance_criteria.words: A split's parent plan gives every child story a mandatory `scope` (files it will change, new files marked new)
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

acceptance_criteria.text: The plan check rejects a split whose story has no files listed, naming that story.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

acceptance_criteria.text: The plan check rejects a split story naming a file missing from the repo and not marked new.
acceptance_criteria.words: each file exists or is marked new
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

stories.title: A story waits unplanned while its files are in flight
stories.user_story: A split story that shares a file with work in flight waits unplanned, and its card says what for.
stories.context: Stories start planning by themselves through start_waiting and start_unblocked in dokima/agent_autopilot.py. Running work is an issue whose worker has started and whose pull request has not merged or closed; its files are its approved plan's scope. A pull request at the merge gate is one whose code review approved it; its files are the files it changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: A story sharing a file with running work's plan scope waits unplanned.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

acceptance_criteria.text: A story sharing a file changed by an open pull request at the merge gate waits unplanned.
acceptance_criteria.words: open pull requests at the merge gate (the files they change)
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

acceptance_criteria.text: A story sharing no file with anything in flight starts planning as today.
acceptance_criteria.words: Before a child plans, code compares its scope with everything in flight in the repo
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

acceptance_criteria.text: Two stories of one split that share a file never start planning together; the later one waits.
acceptance_criteria.words: Siblings that share nothing are still checked against all in-flight work, not started blindly together.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

acceptance_criteria.text: A waiting story's card names the issue or pull request it waits on.
acceptance_criteria.words: its card names what it waits on
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

stories.title: A waiting story plans once the work ahead ends
stories.user_story: A waiting story starts planning on the new main by itself once the work it waits on merges or closes.
stories.context: Closes and merges already reach autopilot_closed in dokima/agent_autopilot.py, which starts issues whose blockers closed; the release can hang off the same place.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the work a story waits on merges, the story starts planning against the new main.
acceptance_criteria.words: Released when that work merges or closes; then it plans against the new main
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the work a story waits on closes without merging, the story starts planning.
acceptance_criteria.words: Released when that work merges or closes
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

stories.title: A plan reaching outside its story's files is checked again
stories.user_story: A story whose full plan needs a file outside its split list is checked again before its worker starts.
stories.context: The worker starts after plan approval, on /work or by autopilot (agent_roles.py). Reuse the in-flight check of story 2 on the plan's extra files.

acceptance_criteria.text: A story whose plan adds a file in flight elsewhere waits before its worker starts.
acceptance_criteria.words: If its full plan needs a file outside its split scope, the same check runs again before work.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

acceptance_criteria.text: That story's worker starts once the work it waits on merges or closes.
acceptance_criteria.words: Released when that work merges or closes
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Its own planner lists them once this story is planned.

raises.label: Single issues unchecked?
raises.text: Your newest design checks only split stories. Should issues never split go unchecked? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: The 2026-10-12 comment speaks only of a child's split scope; a single issue has none before planning.

raises.label: Your command skips wait?
raises.text: Does your own /plan or /work on a waiting story start it right away? The plan assumes it does.
raises.evidence: Your 2026-10-09 comment says /work starts a queued issue right away; the 2026-10-12 rewrite is silent.

raises.label: Which pull requests hold
raises.text: Does every pull request whose code review approved it hold a story back, autopilot or not? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: Your 2026-10-09 comment held only autopilot or merge-queue pull requests; the 2026-10-12 rewrite says merge gate.
